newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AWB Report-Sorghum main factor in east Australia.
newsitem.headline: AWB Report-Sorghum main factor in east Australia.

text.p: Sorghum continued to be the main grain influencing the market on Australia's east coast, with significant stocks available in New South Wales and Queensland states, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said on Friday.
Feed lot industry demand is notably lower, with no change in the near-term expected, the AWB said in its weekly grain market report.
Dairy demand in southern states remains strong given the prevailing dry conditions, it said.
"The new crop feed market is marked by demand in the south but is unmatched by sellers," the AWB said.
Milling wheat continues to be focused on dry conditions in the Victorian and South Australian Mallee region, the AWB said.
There also is some speculaion about protein premiums that may come forward as dry conditions continue, the AWB said.
